notes: NAME (research 2026-07-03): his children's obituaries remember him as 'Frank' ('wife of the late Frank Hohmann', Mary Ann's 1946 obit) and 'John F. Hohmann' (son John A.'s 1948 obit) — his real name was very likely JOHN FRANKLIN HOHMANN, called Frank. 'Franklin P. S.' and the named-for-President-Pierce story are tree embellishment (lore); the son 'Franklin Pierce Hohmann b. 1895' may be the origin of the back-formation.

GEOGRAPHY CORRECTED: this was a MORRISVILLE, Bucks County PA family, not Trenton — no Hohmann entries in Trenton directories 1881/1882/1900 (Trenton Historical Society transcriptions, checked verbatim). St. Francis Hospital, Trenton (d. 30 Jun 1898) was simply the nearest hospital across the river. Census targets: Morrisville borough 1900/1910/1920.

FIVE children confirmed by the 1946 obituary: John A. (1885-1948), Frank(lin Pierce, b. 1895), Anna (unmarried 1946), Bertha (Mrs. HOWARD Albertson — the direct line), and a second daughter Mrs. CHARLES L. Albertson: two Hohmann sisters married Albertson men. Family plot: Morrisville Cemetery, Bucks Co. PA.

FATHER: most plausibly John Heinrich Hohmann (b. 11 Aug 1832 — I182526999844), the man the export mis-attached as a 'child' of the unrelated Braddock splice. DECISIVE DOCUMENT: his own 30 Jun 1898 NJ death certificate (NJ State Archives death index Jun 1878-Dec 1900, searchable free by a human, cert ~$10) — it should name his parents.
The 'Virginia, U.S., Marriage Records, 1936-2014' source on this record is a confirmed stray — nothing in his life touches Virginia.
